description.en: HealthLoopQA evaluates LLM reasoning over continuous diabetes monitoring data through 127 tasks and 1,500 QA instances covering process mining, anomaly detection, and prediction over 30-day horizons, with a fault-injected simulation testbed for safety scenarios.
